name: Morgana Dark Lady
desc: Morgana solo-carries with Dark Star supporting cast. Uncap board at Lv9 for Jhin/Vex secondary AP.

name: Jhin Dark Star Snipers
desc: Sniper line backed by Dark Star damage amp. Jhin one-shots backline carries on his fourth shot.

name: Xayah Stargazer
desc: Stargazer constellation buffs Xayah while Jax tanks. Nunu holds the Stargazer 4-cost slot.

name: Primordian Reroll
desc: Reroll Lv6 for 3-star Rek'Sai and Bel'Veth. Primordian Brawlers stat-check enemies.

name: Mecha Aurelion Sol
desc: Full Mecha frontline pilot ASol, Conduit chain feeds the team mana. Cap board with Bard or Blitzcrank.

name: Zed Galaxy Hunter
desc: Zed solo carry with Rogue + Dark Star backline pressure. Cap board at Lv9.

name: Psionic Pyke Reroll
desc: Reroll at Lv6 for 3-star Pyke. Psionic 4 is the team spike — Sona caps it at 5.

name: Sona Commander
desc: Heal-and-shield Shepherd backbone with Sona broadcasting team-wide buffs. Strong vs sustained DPS, weak vs assassins.

name: Anima Fiora
desc: Fiora carries with Anima frontline support. High variance — needs a Fiora 2-star and Anima 5 for the spike.
